wizard.title: Import contacts
wizard.resumeBanner: You have an unfinished import of {filename}. Continue, or start over?
wizard.resumeExpiry: We keep an unfinished import for 24 hours. After that the file has to be uploaded again.
wizard.backFromPreview: Changing the mapping starts the import over. Nothing is lost, we still have the file.

upload.limits: We accept CSV files. Up to 200 MB.
upload.guide: What the contacts file should look like
upload.unsupportedFormat: We cannot read {filename}. We accept CSV files. Save an Excel workbook as CSV UTF-8 first.
upload.wrongType: We cannot read this format. We accept CSV files.

guide.trigger: What the contacts file should look like
guide.lead: We need a CSV, a text file where the first row holds the column names and every other row is one contact.
guide.sampleHint: The fastest way: open the sample in Excel or Google Sheets, replace the example rows with your contacts and upload it here. We recognise the sample columns on our own.
guide.columnsIntro: We recognise columns by the name in the first row. Case and accents do not matter. Anything we miss you set by hand in the Mapping step, and a column you do not need stays on "Do not use".
guide.columnsCustom: A column that fits none of the fields above can become a custom field right in the Mapping step: click "Create field" under the table. The field is created as text and the values from the file go into it. Leave what you do not need on "Do not use".

email.names: email, e-mail, mail, email address, address
email.note: The only required column. We lowercase the address and trim spaces. A row without an email ends up among the failed ones.

firstName.names: first name, firstname, given name, jméno, křestní
firstName.note: If at least half of the rows hold two words and the file has no separate surname column, we take it as a full name and split it.

lastName.names: last name, lastname, surname, family name, příjmení
lastName.note: We derive gender and the Czech vocative from the surname.

fullName.names: full name, name, celé jméno, jméno a příjmení
fullName.note: We split it into first and last name and separate titles. If the file also has a first or last name column, we ignore this one and tell you.

titlePrefix.note: For example Ing. or MUDr. We can also separate a title out of a full name.

titleSuffix.names: not recognised by name, set it by hand

gender.note: We understand male and female, their Czech forms and the single letter shorthands. Without the column, or when we do not understand a value, we guess from the name and send the uncertain ones to the salutation review.

locale.note: A language code such as cs or en. Without it we use the project language.

tag.names: not recognised by name, set it by hand
tag.note: Separate several tags in one cell with a comma or a pipe. One contact holds at most 50 tags.

guide.formatDelimiter: We detect the delimiter ourselves: semicolon, comma, tab and pipe. You can override it in the File check step.
guide.formatEncoding: We detect the encoding from the Czech letters: UTF-8, Windows-1250, ISO-8859-2, Windows-1252 and ISO-8859-1. We cannot read UTF-16 and UTF-32 files.
guide.formatQuotes: Put a value that contains the delimiter or a line break in quotes. Double a quote that is part of the text.
guide.formatHeader: We treat the first row as a header when its cells are non empty, unique and not numeric. Otherwise we name the columns ourselves and you assign them in the Mapping step.
guide.limitsCell: At most 8,192 characters per cell. We shorten longer ones and tell you.
guide.sourcesExcel: Excel: File, Save as, CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited). We cannot read an .xlsx workbook yet.
guide.sourcesSheets: Google Sheets: File, Download, Comma separated values (.csv).
guide.sourcesOther: Another tool, say Ecomail or Mailchimp: look for a CSV export next to the contact list. We recognise email, first name and last name automatically, the rest you settle in the Mapping step.
guide.missingXlsx: .xlsx and .xls workbooks. Save them as CSV UTF-8.
guide.missingConsentColumns: Consent date and source from a column. The interface cannot set them yet, only the API can.

mapping.title: What is in each column?
mapping.willSplit: We will split this into first and last name
mapping.noEmail: You have not picked the column with the email address. Without it a contact has nowhere to arrive.
mapping.duplicateTarget: Two columns point at {field}: {columns}. Pick one.
mapping.unknownDateFormat: In column {column} we did not recognise the format in {count, plural, =0 {no rows} one {# row} few {# rows} many {# rows} other {# rows}}, for example {example}.

warnings.full_name_ignored: We will not use the „Full name" column: the file has its own first or last name column and that one wins. To split the name from a single column, set the other name columns to „Do not use".

mapping.createFieldFailed: We could not create the field "{name}". Please try again, or leave the column on "Do not use".

preview.title: This is how it will look
preview.vocativeNotice: We are not sure how to address {count, plural, =0 {any contact} one {# contact} few {# contacts} many {# contacts} other {# contacts}}. After the import we will show them to you and let you decide. Until then we greet them neutrally with „Hello" and no name, never wrongly.
preview.noEmailRows: {count, plural, =0 {No row has} one {# row has} few {# rows have} many {# rows have} other {# rows have}} no email, so we will skip them.
preview.duplicateRows: {count, plural, =0 {No email is} one {# email is} few {# emails are} many {# emails are} other {# emails are}} repeated in the file. We keep the last occurrence.
preview.splitTitlesPrefix: Separate titles before the name (Ing., Mgr., MUDr.)
preview.splitTitlesSuffix: Separate titles after the name (Ph.D., CSc., DiS.)

options.title: Three last questions
options.tagHint: Tip: a tag comes in handy when you want to find this group later.
options.conflict: What if we already have the contact?
options.conflictSkipHint: We keep what we have, nothing from the file.
options.conflictUpdateHint: We add what is missing. What we already have stays.
options.conflictErrorHint: A second occurrence of the same address ends up among the failed rows.
options.declaration: I confirm that these people agreed to receive commercial messages, or that I have another legal ground for it.
options.declarationEvidence: It is stored as evidence, including the date and my name.
options.duplicateErrorUnavailable: For a file this size we cannot reliably spot a second occurrence of the same address, so we do not offer this option.
options.submit: Import {count, plural, =0 {no contacts} one {# contact} few {# contacts} many {# contacts} other {# contacts}}
options.listHint: Required. A contact with no list has nothing to receive and nothing to unsubscribe from, so we always file it somewhere.
options.listRequired: Pick the list these contacts belong to, or create a new one right here.
options.newListNameHint: Only you and your colleagues see it. We create the list with double opt-in; you can switch that in its settings.
options.newListNameRequired: Write what the new list should be called.
options.newListFailed: We could not create the list. Please try again, or pick one of the existing ones.
options.newListCreated: The list {name} is ready and we will file the contacts into it.
options.subscriptionConfirmedHint: These people already gave their consent, we send them no confirmation email.
options.subscriptionPendingHint: We add them to the list as unconfirmed. A campaign reaches them only after they confirm.
options.declarationRequired: A double opt-in list needs the declaration ticked, otherwise we cannot write the contacts down as confirmed.
options.declarationExplainTitle: What you confirm with the declaration
options.declarationExplainBody: That these people asked for your messages, or that you have another legal ground to write to them, a past purchase for instance. The declaration is evidence: we store it with the import and with every contact consent, together with the date and your name, so you have something to show in case of a complaint or an audit.
options.declarationExplainWhen: The import runs without the declaration too, we just write the contacts into the list as unconfirmed and ask them for confirmation ourselves.
options.submitTarget: We will file the contacts into the list {list}, subscription state: {status}.

warnings.number_format_ambiguous: {n} numbers could be read two ways: 1,234 can be 1.234 as well as 1234. We read them as {interpretation}.
warnings.value_truncated: {n} values were longer than the field allows, we shortened them.
warnings.name_split_low_confidence: {n} names could not be split reliably into a first and a last name.
warnings.vietnamese_order_assumed: For {n} names we used the Vietnamese order (surname first).
warnings.gender_unknown: {n} contacts have no gender, we will greet them neutrally.
warnings.gender_conflict: In {n} contacts the first and the last name disagree on gender.
warnings.vocative_low_confidence: We are not sure how to address {n} contacts.
warnings.non_latin_script: {n} names are not in the Latin script, we did not compute a greeting.
warnings.suppressed_skipped: We did not add {n} addresses, because they unsubscribed in the past or their emails kept failing.
warnings.trailing_fields_padded: {n} rows had fewer columns than the header, we left the missing ones empty.
warnings.contact_tag_limit_reached: We did not add some tags for {n} contacts, because one contact can carry at most 50 of them.

too_many_rows.title: The file has too many rows
too_many_rows.nextStep: The file has more than 5 million rows. Split it into parts.

too_many_columns.title: The file has too many columns
too_many_columns.nextStep: The file has more than 200 columns. Remove the ones you do not need.

empty_file.title: The file is empty
empty_file.nextStep: The file is empty, we found no rows in it.

unsupported_encoding.title: We cannot read the encoding of the file
unsupported_encoding.nextStep: Save it in Excel through File, Save as, CSV UTF-8 and try again.

delimiter_not_detected.title: We could not recognise the separator
delimiter_not_detected.nextStep: Pick the separator by hand in the File check step.

malformed_csv.title: The file is damaged
malformed_csv.nextStep: A closing quote is missing. Open the file in Excel and save it again.

no_email_column_mapped.title: The email column is missing
no_email_column_mapped.nextStep: Go back to the Mapping step and pick the column with the email address.

storage_unavailable.title: We could not store the file
storage_unavailable.nextStep: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, check the free disk space on the server.

upload_failed.title: We could not send the file
upload_failed.nextStep: Please try again. If it keeps happening, copy the technical detail and let us know: {detail}

contact_limit_reached.title: You reached the contact limit
contact_limit_reached.nextStep: Delete unused contacts, or raise the limit in the project settings.

vocative.groupHint: The name {name} can be either male or female. How should we address them?
